text:
Jordyn: Passing Axiom Health to CS — signed with BAA. ACV $300k (MRR $25k). Pilot window target 2026-04-20. Requirements: private deploy (VPC), Okta SSO, KMS integration for key provenance, strict PHI logging. Sales warned of a possible launch surge (~900 reqs/min). Main risks: SAML metadata timing, cert rotation, GCP peering maintenance. cc @mike @anais

Mike: Ill own onboarding + security runbook. Need Okta admin contact and whether customer will upload certs or use our assisted flow. Also will need KMS policy details.

Jordyn: Okta admin is security+id@axiomhealth.com. Sales uploaded a stub SAML file to the account folder (internal). Customer plans to manage certs but asked for our sample commands and a dry-run.

Anais: Ill open infra tickets now. Creating SUP-9999 for SSO and ENG-7777 for VPC peering/preflight. Eng will need CIDR blocks, peer project IDs, and preferred maintenance windows.

infra-bot: Created ENG-7777 (axiom-vpc-peering) and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

Mike: Action list (Ill track): 1) Obtain final SAML XML from security+id@axiomhealth.com (owner: mike, due: 2026-04-01) 2) Share cert dry-run guide + sample openssl / acme commands (owner: jordyn, due: 2026-03-30) 3) ENG preflight + ENG-7777 (owner: anais) 4) Schedule enablement + PHI runbook session (owner: mike, target: 2026-04-10) 5) Surge plan & temporary burst nodes (owner: ops, note: ops to confirm cost and availability)

Jordyn: Renewal note — 12mo term. Recommend QBR planning at month 8 to review adoption and discuss expansion. Flagging renewal-risk: medium because clinical teams will evaluate ROI.

Anais: Left a comment on ENG-7777 requesting CIDR and peer project ID from security+id@axiomhealth.com. Also added a checklist: firewall rules, DNS routes, MTU validation.

opsbot: Created SUP-9999 and scheduled a follow-up reminder: 2026-04-05 09:00 PT.

Mike: Quick smoke test for CS to validate once staging is provisioned:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"input":"PHI redaction check: Patient: Maria Lopez, SSN: 987-65-4321"}'
```

Jordyn: Customer wants a go/no-go sync 2026-04-15. Please surface any blockers by 2026-04-01 so we can escalate.

Anais: Noted. Ill follow up on ENG-7777 and post the preflight runbook link here once done.

Mike: Will prepare the security slide "PHI handling + KMS notes" for enablement. Also proposing we request 3x A100 burst nodes for peak day; ops, can you confirm feasibility and cost?

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up 2026-04-05 09:00 PT.

Jordyn: Thanks team — Im available to join cert/DNS calls. :thumbsup:
